**Why first:** Pennsylvania began statewide death registration in 1906, so a death certificate almost certainly exists. **Why third:** Flynn born ~1845 in PA almost certainly had Irish immigrant parents (Famine-era arrivals). The death certificate may answer this partially, but a dedicated parentage question sets up Irish origin research — a separate and substantial thread.
